svg.text: One sheared fragment, drawn at its left end after every step of the TruSeq DNA PCR-free front end.
a 3' overhang, and a 5' end with no phosphate
blunt, 5'-P, 3'-OH: one state, not a mixture
a single 3' A: only a T can answer it
both nicks sealed; the stem stays shut
the A/T pair, and one nick on each strand for the ligase
the molecule is unchanged; the population is not
The fourth operation, copy, never happens here: the molecule that was ligated is the one that is read.
